answer: The bedrock check is Chartered balancemaker screw log under chamber endorsement. Under it sits 4-year workshop service, 157 supervised fittings, escapement exam, annual fees, and no template can dig around it. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 754 fakes need 754, at 119 POA each, totalling 89726 POA. Open the tide and you find a clerk, open the thread and you find a bill, open the beacon and you find a date. Pay the price or stay outside: the pool belongs to whoever paid.
